name: outlook
description: Read and triage Microsoft Outlook mail + calendar via Microsoft Graph as the signed-in user. Delegated permissions; draft-only mail.

clientId.description: Override the embedded Entra app id.

tokenCachePath.description: Path to the MSAL token cache. Defaults to ~/.outlook-cli/tokens.json.

account.description: UPN to use when multiple accounts are cached. Required for multi-account hosts.
